content: इरिणम् [ऋ-इनच्-किदिच्च <ls>Uṇ. 2. 51.</ls>] .²1 A salt-ground, saline soil; यथेरिणे बीजमुप्त्वा न वप्ता लभते फलम् <ls>Ms. 3. 142</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 151</ls>. .²2 Hence, a bare or barren soil, desert, dreary region. .²3 Non-support. .²4 A rivulet, well (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²5 A hollow, hole. .²6 A dice-board; प्रवातेजा इरिणे वर्वृताना <ls>Rv. 10. 34. 1</ls>. .{@-णः@} Calamus Scriptorious (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>बोरू</ns>), <ls>Mb. 2</ls>.
